description: Closes a document. Refuses one with unsaved changes unless discard, and one the agent did not open or create (document.new, document.open) unless users_document, which is only for when the user asked for it to be closed.

document.description: The document: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

discard.description: Close it even though it has unsaved changes, losing them. Default false.

users_document.description: Close it even though the agent did not open or create it. Only when the user asked for this document to be closed. Default false.
